gallery.filename: Plaza During Bicycle Races 1901 Bacolod, Western Negros.jpg
gallery.title: File:Plaza During Bicycle Races 1901 Bacolod, Western Negros.jpg
gallery.artist: Dean Conant Worcester  (born October 1, 1866; died 1924) (Dean Conant Worcester's Photographs of the Philippine Islands)
gallery.credit: Plaza during bicycle races : Bacalod, Western Negros -- 1901; 116; 1901, The United States and its Territories 1870 - 1925: The Age of Imperialism, Philippine Photographs Digital Archive, Special Collections Library, University of Michigan
gallery.source: Plaza During Bicycle Races 1901 Bacolod, Western Negros
gallery.description: Bacolod Public Plaza during bicycle races in 1901, Municipality of Bacolod, Western Negros, United States Territory (presently: City of Bacolod, Negros Occidental, Philippines). The "bicycles" are actually two-wheeled single horse-drawn carriages. In the Philippines, it is known  as calesa () or carretela ().
